name: autoexec_job_phase_runner
label: Automation Job Stage: Runner Table
description: The runner table for the automation phase is used for tracking automated statuses, time dimension statistics, and query associations, suitable for reporting scenarios.

fields.name: job_id
fields.description: Job ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: job_phase_id
fields.description: Job script ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: runner_map_id
fields.description: Job script runner ID maps to ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: lcd
fields.description: Last updated time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the job_phase_id, runner_map_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_jobid_status
indexes.description: Standard index covering the job_id, status fields, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_lcd
indexes.description: Standard index covering the lcd field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_runner_map_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the runner_map_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
